'''Clubs''' were blunt weapons used by a variety of [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Description==
Clubs were simple melee weapons that were among the first weapons created by [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]]. They were manufactured of a variety of materials, and over the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] the materials improved to be more effective. Clubs were swung by their wielders, using their brute strength to inflict injury and damage. When swung hard enough, clubs could break [[Skeleton/Legends|bones]] and even [[Death/Legends|kill]].<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

A variety of club was the [[Baton/Legends|baton]], which was used by [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police forces]] for various purposes including [[Riot|crowd control]].<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> Some species had their own traditional clubs. A [[Thogk]] was a traditional [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] club which literally translated to "log with a spike in it" in [[Gamorrese]]. The [[Icehead club]] was a wooden bludgeon used by members of the [[Icehead]] species.

==History==
[[File:Wicket_club.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]] the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] wielding a club]]
The semi-sentient [[Gundark/Legends|Gundark]] species preferred fighting with their bare hands, but would use a club when necessary.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref>

The [[Unwashed]], a [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of the [[Anointed People]], commonly carried a club. During the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Anointed People would participate in traditional mock battles using only clubs which could do little damage against the strong-boned species.<ref name="Godking">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>

Clubs were used by two species native to the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], namely the [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]]<ref name="The Adventures of Teebo">''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]''</ref> and the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]].<ref name="The Ewoks Join the Fight ">[[The Ewoks Join the Fight (storybook)|''The Ewoks Join the Fight'' storybook]]</ref> [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]], the king of a tribe of Duloks on Endor during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], wielded a very large club. During the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Ewoks used clubs, [[Hatchet (weapon)|hatchets]], and [[Arrow/Legends|arrows]] against [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="The Ewoks Join the Fight" />

The club was also used by [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] warrior [[Cakhmaim]], who viewed it as his favorite weapon. A warrior of the [[Cilare]] species named [[Arbeloa]] was able to to defeat multiple [[Yuuzhan Vong]] armed only with a club.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 4">[[Invasion 4|''Invasion'' 4]]</ref>
